- [x] Update placeholder text in PlayerFrameCommentOverlay.tsx to say "Comment on this recording? Use @ to mention team members"
- [x] Add minRows prop to LemonRichContentEditor component
- [x] Apply minRows={3} only to the player frame comment overlay modal
- [x] Revert global min-height change from SCSS file
- [x] Use style attribute for dynamic height (Tailwind cannot process runtime values)
- [x] Run linting and formatting - all checks passed

## Changes Made

### 1. Updated Placeholder Text
Changed from "Comment on this recording?" to "Comment on this recording? Use @ to mention team members" in `PlayerFrameCommentOverlay.tsx`

### 2. Added minRows Prop to LemonRichContentEditor
- Added optional `minRows?: number` prop to `LemonRichContentEditorProps` type
- Applied min-height styling using inline style attribute (not Tailwind className)
- Only affects instances where minRows is explicitly specified

### 3. Applied minRows to Player Comment Modal Only
- Set `minRows={3}` in PlayerFrameCommentOverlay.tsx to provide 3 lines of visible space
- Other LemonRichContentEditor instances remain unaffected

### 4. Technical Note on Styling Approach
The implementation uses inline `style` attribute rather than Tailwind className because:
- Tailwind processes class names at build time, not runtime
- Dynamic template literals like `min-h-[${minRows * 1.5}em]` cannot be evaluated by Tailwind's JIT compiler
- Inline styles are the correct approach for dynamic, computed values in React
